messages:
Marta Gomez: Hey team, unboxing my new M2 Air and hitting Activation Lock during setup. It asks for a previous owner's Apple ID. MDM enrollment won't proceed past that screen. Did shipment sometimes include refurbished devices?
Eric Wu (IT): welcome Marta! can you grab the serial from the Activation Lock screen (or System Settings > About if you can get past)? we'll check ABM.
Marta Gomez: serial G0M2X1Z5H9Q. The screen literally says 'This device is linked to an Apple ID'. I can't get to About.
mdm-bot: Device G0M2X1Z5H9Q: enrollment blocked by Activation Lock. ABM lookup pending.
Eric Wu (IT): thanks. if it's Activation Lock we need to remove it from Apple Business Manager (ABM) or request Apple support with proof of purchase. tagging hardware ops. @Leo Park can you see if this serial is in our ABM list?
Leo Park: checking ABM now. quick note: occasionally vendor returns slip in ABM causes this. If ABM has it we can unassign the Apple ID and reassign to our MDM; if not, we escalate with Apple.
abm-bot: ABM query: serial G0M2X1Z5H9Q found. Assigned to Apple ID appleid_prev@vendor.example.com. Device status: Assigned to Customer.
Marta Gomez: ahh that explains it. is there a way to clear that without vendor involvement?
Eric Wu (IT): I'll open a case to request removal from ABM. ETA depends on vendor responsiveness, could be same day or a couple business days. Two options: 1) request vendor remove association (fast if they respond), 2) RMA for a replacement unit (longer logistics). Which do you prefer?
Marta Gomez: prefer to wait for vendor if it's usually quick. I don't have any meetings this afternoon so can be patient.
Eric Wu (IT): opened ticket IT-2248: "ABM remove AppleID for G0M2X1Z5H9Q" and CC'd procurement. Pinging vendor contact in ticket.
mdm-bot: IT-2248 created. ABM unlink request submitted. We'll notify this thread when ABM confirms.
Leo Park: procurement pinged vendor. sometimes vendor does a bulk unassign in ABM within a few hours. I'll follow up.
Marta Gomez: thanks! curious — if ABM unassigns will my FileVault or any data be affected?
Eric Wu (IT): no user data on a new device, but once ABM is cleared you can complete setup, enroll in MDM, and we'll push the Standard Employee profile which will start FileVault and escrow the recovery key. No data loss expected.
abm-bot: ABM update: vendor processed removal for serial G0M2X1Z5H9Q. Device now unassigned and available.
mdm-bot: ABM confirms unassign. Initiating Autoprovisioning: enrollment token reissued.
Marta Gomez: retried setup and it worked! MDM enrollment completed and FileVault started (0% -> 6% within a few mins). Thanks so much everyone.
Eric Wu (IT): great news. I'll close IT-2248 once procurement confirms with vendor. Welcome aboard Marta! Ping me if anything else blocks the onboarding steps.
Leo Park: welcome! if you want a replacement unit in future for peace of mind let us know and we can set that up.
Marta Gomez: will do, appreciate the speedy help :heart:
